message: config.disable-tls in composer.json is "yes", which downloads without TLS and turns off secure-http: a package or its metadata can be changed on the way
fix: Remove disable-tls from config in composer.json, and serve the repository that needs it over HTTPS

message: config.allow-plugins in composer.json has "*": true, which lets every Composer plugin run its code, but installScripts in depcurfew.json denies dependency code by default
fix: List the plugins that may run in installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (with the prefix composer:) and run depcurfew apply, then remove "*" from config.allow-plugins

message: config.policy in composer.json is false, which turns off every dependency policy, the cooldown and malware blocking included
fix: Remove policy from config in composer.json, then run depcurfew apply
